snippet.title: Neidfyre Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose. 

Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4206080/Neidfyre
